title: US military fires on cargo ship in Gulf of Oman over alleged blockade breach
detail: A feed summary reports the US military fired on a cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman after it reportedly tried to breach the US blockade of Iran. Only the headline summary was available; the vessel, damage and casualties are not disclosed and the report is unverified.

title: US launches task force to disrupt Iran's land-based supply routes
detail: Al Jazeera reports the US has launched a task force aimed at disrupting Iran's land-based supply routes, targeting the ground transport of weapons and materiel.

title: Iran says it is waiting to resume talks with US after midterms 'shock'
detail: Al Jazeera reports Iran's foreign minister says Tehran is waiting to resume talks with the US following the American midterm elections.

media.caption: Iran waiting to resume talks after US midterms

title: Iran threatens to 'rain down hell' if US escalates war
detail: Al Jazeera reports Iranian officials warned of a severe response if the US escalates the war.

media.caption: Iran threatens to rain down hell if US escalates

title: Trump calls fresh Iran war 'highly unlikely' but keeps military option open; Jerusalem Post sources say he held off a strike
detail: Feed summaries report Trump called a fresh war with Iran 'highly unlikely' while keeping the military option on the table. A separate Jerusalem Post-sourced report says Trump held off on an Iran strike as Israel and the US prepared for a military operation. Only headlines were available; the strike-delay claim is unverified.
